challenges.name: class-rosters-waitlist
challenges.title: Build the class rosters with a waitlist
challenges.description: On the first day of term, Sen Academy's portal replays the sign-up log to build every class roster. Write Enroll, Cancel and Report: give each sign-up a seat while the class has room and put the rest on a first-come-first-served waitlist, ignore repeated sign-ups (student ids are case-insensitive), move the first waiting student into a seat when an enrolled student cancels, and print one line per class sorted by course code. The test runner reads capacity, enroll and cancel commands and prints your report.

tests.name: The example: a double-click and a full class
tests.input:
capacity ANH7-B 3
enroll HS-1024 ANH7-B
enroll HS-1024 ANH7-B
enroll HS-1026 ANH7-B
enroll HS-1027 ANH7-B
enroll HS-1028 ANH7-B
tests.expected: ANH7-B 3/3: HS-1024, HS-1026, HS-1027 | waitlist: HS-1028

tests.name: A cancellation gives the seat to the first waiting student
tests.input:
capacity TOAN9-A 2
capacity ANH7-B 2
enroll HS-1024 ANH7-B
enroll HS-1025 TOAN9-A
enroll HS-1026 ANH7-B
enroll HS-1027 ANH7-B
enroll HS-1028 ANH7-B
cancel HS-1024 ANH7-B
tests.expected:
ANH7-B 2/2: HS-1026, HS-1027 | waitlist: HS-1028
TOAN9-A 1/2: HS-1025 | waitlist: -

tests.name: Student ids are case-insensitive
tests.input:

enroll hs-1029 LY10-A
